summary.text: Michael Rodrigues is a Democratic state senator from Massachusetts who has represented the 1st Bristol and Plymouth District since January 2011 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the Senate Committee on Ways and Means and previously served in the state House from 1996 to 2011.

paragraphs.text: Rodrigues was born on May 30, 1959, and earned a bachelor's degree from Southeastern Massachusetts University in 1983.
His professional experience includes working as president and treasurer of ABC Floor Covering.
Rodrigues represented the 8th Bristol District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 1996 to 2011.
He assumed office in the Senate on January 5, 2011.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Ways and Means Committee and the Joint Committee on Ways and Means.
